params.name: id
params.description: Entity public ID (`ent_...`). A merged-away id transparently resolves to the surviving entity.

params.name: direction
params.description: Which edges to return relative to the entity. Defaults to `both`.

params.name: relationType
params.description: Exact-match filter on the relation label.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of edges to return (default 50, max 200).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor: return edges whose KSUID sorts after this value.

params.name: bucket
params.description:
Optional bucket public ID (`bkt_...`) to scope the read to one bucket.
Omit for the unscoped (all account+environment) view.

params.name: nodeID
params.description:
Center the graph on this entity (`ent_...`) and only return the subgraph
within `maxDepth` hops of it; every node then carries its `depth` (hops
from the center, center = 0). Omit for the uncentered whole-graph view.
`rootNodeID` and `focusNodeID` are accepted as aliases.

params.name: maxDepth
params.description:
Maximum hops from the center node. Only meaningful with `nodeID`. Defaults
to 2 and is clamped down to a system maximum (5).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of edges per page (default 50, max 200).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor: return edges whose KSUID sorts after this value.

params.name: type
params.description:
Restrict to entities of these types. An edge is returned only when BOTH
of its endpoints survive the type filter.

params.name: since
params.description: Only edges created at/after this RFC 3339 timestamp.

params.name: search
params.description:
Case-insensitive substring match on canonical names. Both endpoints of an
edge must match for the edge (and its nodes) to be returned.

params.name: bucket
params.description:
Optional bucket public ID (`bkt_...`) to scope the read to one bucket.
Omit for the unscoped (all account+environment) view.
